title: StratoNext
description: Exports a StratoNext organization (workspaces, environments, agents, projects, tasks, scheduled jobs and reports) into Port, and lets Port workflows dispatch StratoNext tasks

configurations.name: stratonextAuthDomain
configurations.description: Auth domain of the StratoNext machine identity, e.g. api.prod.stratonext.com/oauth2/agent-token

configurations.name: stratonextAuthClientId
configurations.description: Client id of the StratoNext machine identity

configurations.name: stratonextAuthClientSecret
configurations.description: Client secret of the StratoNext machine identity

configurations.name: portWebhookSecret
configurations.description: Shared secret Port workflow WEBHOOK nodes must send as the X-StratoNext-Secret header. Only needed for the /integration/tasks/* webhook fallback; the native actions below do not use it.

actions.name: create_task
actions.description: Create a StratoNext task without dispatching it

inputs.name: name
inputs.title: Task name
inputs.description: Short name for the task

inputs.name: description
inputs.title: Description
inputs.description: What the agent should achieve

inputs.name: instructions
inputs.title: Instructions
inputs.description: Optional step-by-step instructions for the agent

inputs.name: workspaceId
inputs.title: Workspace ID
inputs.description: StratoNext workspace to create the task in (a stratonextWorkspace identifier). Optional when projectId is given: the project's workspace is used.

inputs.name: projectId
inputs.title: Project ID
inputs.description: StratoNext project to file the task under (a stratonextProject identifier)

inputs.name: assigneeId
inputs.title: Assignee ID
inputs.description: StratoNext agent to assign the task to (a stratonextAgent identifier)

inputs.name: environmentId
inputs.title: Environment ID
inputs.description: Target environment (a stratonextEnvironment identifier). Use when the work is not tied to a project deployment.

inputs.name: deploymentId
inputs.title: Deployment ID
inputs.description: Target deployment. Preferred for project work: the agent resolves the environment, stack and region from it.

inputs.name: verificationCriteria
inputs.title: Verification criteria
inputs.description: How StratoNext should verify the task is done

inputs.name: idempotencyKey
inputs.title: Idempotency key
inputs.description: Optional. Defaults to the run id, so a Port retry returns the original task instead of a duplicate.

actions.name: dispatch_task
actions.description: Dispatch a StratoNext task to an agent. Pass taskId for an existing task, or the create_task inputs to create and dispatch in one step.

inputs.name: taskId
inputs.title: Task ID
inputs.description: Existing task to dispatch. Leave empty to create one from the inputs below.

inputs.name: name
inputs.title: Task name
inputs.description: Required when taskId is empty

inputs.name: description
inputs.title: Description
inputs.description: Required when taskId is empty

inputs.name: instructions
inputs.title: Instructions
inputs.description: Optional step-by-step instructions for the agent

inputs.name: workspaceId
inputs.title: Workspace ID
inputs.description: StratoNext workspace to create the task in (a stratonextWorkspace identifier). Optional when projectId is given: the project's workspace is used.

inputs.name: projectId
inputs.title: Project ID
inputs.description: StratoNext project to file the task under

inputs.name: assigneeId
inputs.title: Assignee ID
inputs.description: StratoNext agent to assign the task to

inputs.name: environmentId
inputs.title: Environment ID
inputs.description: Target environment

inputs.name: deploymentId
inputs.title: Deployment ID
inputs.description: Target deployment, preferred for project work

inputs.name: verificationCriteria
inputs.title: Verification criteria
inputs.description: How StratoNext should verify the task is done

inputs.name: idempotencyKey
inputs.title: Idempotency key
inputs.description: Optional. Defaults to the run id.

actions.name: cancel_task
actions.description: Cancel a queued or running StratoNext task

inputs.name: taskId
inputs.title: Task ID
inputs.description: The task to cancel (a stratonextTask identifier)
